mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full rebuilt or reconditioned engine replacement for a Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 typically ranges from £4,200 to £6,500 for supply only, depending on the specialist and the extent of upgrades included. Used engines start around £1,500 but carry higher risk, while rebuilt units include upgraded components and a 12-month warranty.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of a failing 204PT engine in a Land Rover Discovery Sport P200?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common early warning signs in the Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 are unexplained coolant loss, a distinct rattling noise from the front of the engine on cold starts (timing chain rattle), or illuminated temperature warning lights. You should also check for sweet-smelling exhaust or oil residue around the valve cover.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Land Rover Discovery Sport P200?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A typical Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 holds a UK market value of £15,000-£28,000, making a £4,200-£6,500 rebuilt engine a financially sound investment that preserves the vehicle's performance, reliability and strong resale value for years to come.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service for a Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 typically takes 2 to 4 days, depending on the specialist's workload and whether any ancillary components like the cooling system are being upgraded simultaneously. Sourcing a quality rebuilt unit may add a few days.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between the Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 and the D180/D200 engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 uses a 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-4 petrol engine (204PT) producing 200 PS, prioritising smooth, responsive performance and refinement. In contrast, the D180/D200 uses a 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-4 diesel engine (204DTD) focused on low-end torque and fuel economy for heavy towing or high-mileage driving.

Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Water Pump & Cooling System Failure - Why the Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 204PT Overheats
problems.affectedModels: Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 (204PT / AJ200P, 2019-present)
problems.rootCause: Plastic components in the cooling system (thermostat housing, water pump) can become brittle under sustained thermal cycling, leading to coolant leaks and subsequent overheating risks.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace water pump, thermostat, and hoses with upgraded metal/composite parts.
repairOptions.longevity: Extends life significantly if caught before overheating damage occurs.

repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the engine has already suffered thermal damage or warped heads.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 of relevant age (2019-present) currently holds a UK market value of approximately £15,000-£28,000 [THIRD-PARTY - Auto Trader market observations]. At this premium value band, a reconditioned or rebuilt engine replacement is a small fraction of the vehicle's worth and easily justifies the investment to preserve performance and resale value.
problems.recommendation: If your Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 is exhibiting minor coolant seepage but has not suffered thermal damage, a targeted preventative cooling system refresh by a JLR specialist is the most cost-effective route. However, if the engine has overheated, a full rebuilt replacement is the only reliable long-term solution.

problems.h4: Timing Chain Stretch - Why the Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 204PT Requires Attention
problems.affectedModels: Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 (204PT / AJ200P, 2019-present)
problems.rootCause: Over time, the timing chain tensioners can lose hydraulic pressure, allowing the chain to stretch and produce a characteristic rattling noise on cold starts. If ignored, this can lead to catastrophic internal engine damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Strip front covers, replace timing chain, guides and updated tensioner assembly.
repairOptions.longevity: The definitive fix for chain rattle; prevents catastrophic valve-to-piston contact if addressed promptly.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded valvetrain components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Recommended only if chain failure has already caused internal engine damage.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: As above, the £15,000-£28,000 value of a Land Rover Discovery Sport P200 makes targeted repairs like a timing chain refresh highly viable. A full engine replacement is rarely justified for chain rattle alone unless secondary damage has occurred.
problems.recommendation: Do not ignore a cold-start rattle in your Land Rover Discovery Sport P200. A timely chain and tensioner replacement by a specialist is a well-documented fix that preserves the engine's longevity at a fraction of the cost of a full rebuild.
